blocks.value: VWAP stands for Volume Weighted Average Price. It shows the average price of a stock throughout the trading day while considering trading volume.

Imagine This: Imagine calculating the average marks of a class. Students with more exams contribute more to the final average. VWAP follows a similar idea by giving more importance to trades with higher volume.
Many professional traders use VWAP to understand whether a stock is trading above or below its average price for the day.
If the current price is above VWAP, buyers may currently have greater control. If it's below VWAP, sellers may be stronger.
VWAP is mainly used for intraday trading because it resets every trading day.
